case.title: Master Agreement
case.summary: Debra Perlingiere sends a draft Master Agreement to Cargill.

branch_event.subject: Master Agreement
branch_event.snippet:
Attached for your review, is a draft of a Master Firm Purchase/Sale Agreement 
between Cargill, Incorporated and Enron North America Corp.  Please do not 
hesitate to give me a call with your questions and or comments regarding this 
matter.



Regards,
Debra Perlingiere
Enron North America Corp.
Legal Department
1400 Smith Street, EB 3885
Houston, Texas 77002
dperlin@enron.com
Phone 713-853-7658
Fax  713-646-3490

candidates.label: Internal hold and legal review
candidates.prompt: Keep the material inside Enron, route it through legal first, and hold the outside send until a clean version is ready.

candidates.label: Sanitized status note
candidates.prompt: Send one short status note with no attachment, set a clear owner, and promise the cleaned-up next step.

candidates.label: Limited external review
candidates.prompt: Keep the external loop tight, send only the minimum needed material, and ask one outside reviewer for targeted comments.

candidates.label: Broad external send
candidates.prompt: Send the material now, widen the outside circulation, and ask for fast comments from the broader group.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports recurring earnings growth in 1997 and sets up 1998 growth platform
history_preview.snippet: Archived year-end earnings release describing 1997 results and the company's 1998 growth posture.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports second quarter 1998 earnings of $0.42 per share
history_preview.snippet: Archived second-quarter 1998 earnings release describing continued wholesale growth and contract execution.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports third quarter 1998 earnings and raises the annual dividend
history_preview.snippet: Archived third-quarter 1998 earnings release covering wholesale growth, retail expansion, and dividend increase.

history_preview.subject: FY1998 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $31.26B, net income was $703M, total assets were $29.35B, shareholders' equity was $7.05B, and diluted EPS was $1.01.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports increased earnings results for the first quarter of 1999
history_preview.snippet: Archived first-quarter 1999 earnings release describing wholesale strength, retail contracting, and growing credit-market exposure.

history_preview.subject: FY1999 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $40.11B, net income was $893M, total assets were $33.38B, shareholders' equity was $9.57B, and diluted EPS was $1.10.

history_preview.subject: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

history_preview.subject: Enron files its Form 10-K for fiscal year 1999
history_preview.snippet: Annual report and Form 10-K filing covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 1999.

history_preview.subject: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
history_preview.snippet: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported first-quarter revenues of $13.1B, net income of $338M, and diluted EPS of $0.40.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
history_preview.snippet: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

history_preview.subject: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

history_preview.subject: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
history_preview.snippet: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported second-quarter revenues of $16.9B, net income of $289M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
history_preview.snippet: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

history_preview.subject: Q3 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported third-quarter revenues of $30.0B, net income of $292M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Fitch baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: FY2000 Form 10-K
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $100.79B, net income was $979M, total assets were $65.50B, shareholders' equity was $11.47B, and diluted EPS was $1.12.

history_preview.subject: Moody's baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at Baa1 in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: S&P baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: Q4 2000 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported recurring annual diluted EPS of $1.47 for 2000 and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.41.

history_preview.subject: PG&E files for Chapter 11 protection
history_preview.snippet: SEC filing record documenting PG&E's April 6, 2001 bankruptcy filing.

history_preview.subject: PG&E entered Chapter 11
history_preview.snippet: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

candidate.prompt: Keep the external loop tight, send only the minimum needed material, and ask one outside reviewer for targeted comments.

candidate.label: Internal hold and legal review
candidate.prompt: Keep the material inside Enron, route it through legal first, and hold the outside send until a clean version is ready.

candidate.label: Broad external send
candidate.prompt: Send the material now, widen the outside circulation, and ask for fast comments from the broader group.

Paul


   
	Enron Capital & Trade Resources Corp.
	
	From:  GILBERGD@sullcrom.com                           25/01/2000 17:50
	

To: Mark Taylor/HOU/ECT@ECT, psimons@enron.co.uk

candidate.prompt: Keep one business owner with legal, align internally fast, and send the clean next step once the owner is ready.

candidate.prompt: Limit the outside loop to one counsel contact and one Enron owner, then ask for a single written view.

candidate.prompt: Keep the thread in the legal lane, consolidate comments internally, and move only one clean answer back out.

case.title: Arbitration Guidance
case.summary: Arbitration guidance from outside counsel enters the Enron legal loop.

branch_event.subject: Re: Arbitration
branch_event.snippet:
Dan Lyons
01/19/2000 09:40 AM
To: Richard B Sanders/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc: rstephens@bracepatt.com 
Subject: Arbitration

What is the current scorecard on thee matters....Last time I heard it was yes 
on arbitration and no on waivers of jury trials..Is that still the paradigm?
---------------------- Forwarded by Dan Lyons/HOU/ECT on 01/19/2000 09:38 AM 
---------------------------


"Robert Stephens" <rstephens@bracepatt.com> on 01/19/2000 08:28:53 AM
To: Dan Lyons/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc:  
Subject: Arbitration



Are we arbitration or litigation friendly now?  If litigation, are we juries 
or no juries?

case.title: PG&E Financial Power Deal
case.summary: A financial power deal is moving with counterpart and legal pressure.

branch_event.subject: PG&E Financial Power Deal
branch_event.snippet:
Larry Joe Hunter
05/12/99 02:03 PM
To: Kelly Minear/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc: Dale Neuner/HOU/ECT@ECT, Sara Shackleton/HOU/ECT@ECT 
Subject: PG&E Financial Power Deal

Kelly,

On 5/11 we traded a Financial Power deal with PG&E Energy Trading - Power 
L.P., EW9838.  We had previously been notified by Credit/Legal that no 
Financial Power deals were to be done with this C/P.  Please advise.

Thanks,
Joe

case.title: Weekly FERC Gas Regulatory Report
case.summary: A regulatory report is forwarded with legal and trading cues.

branch_event.subject: Re: Weekly FERC Gas Regulatory Report
branch_event.snippet:
From:  Dari Dornan                           01/10/2000 08:33 AM
	

To: Drew Fossum/ET&S/Enron@ENRON
cc:  

Subject: Weekly FERC Gas Regulatory Report

Drew - notice the CNG filing of a non conforming service agreement because 
the agreement requires the shipper to utilize CNG for its full requirements.  
Northern has determined that such a clause falls under the discount provision 
of "to specified quantities".    Dari
---------------------- Forwarded by Dari Dornan/ET&S/Enron on 01/10/2000 
08:19 AM ---------------------------


Shelley Corman
01/07/2000 06:05 PM
To: Tim Aron/ET&S/

branch_event.subject: URGENT RE: ETOL INTEREST RATE SWAP
branch_event.snippet:
Cynthia L Schneider
12/16/98 10:40 AM
To: Mark - ECT Legal Taylor/HOU/ECT@ECT, Yao Apasu/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc: William S Bradford/HOU/ECT@ECT 
Subject: URGENT RE: ETOL INTEREST RATE SWAP

Attached please find the credit term sheet for the Master ISDA Agmt. between 
ETOL and {ECT or RMT} - whichever US entity Steven Douglas determines is 
appropriate.  I will send the Intercreditor Agmt. to you via cc:mail as well. 
As you know, this is a rush situation.

candidate.prompt: Collapse the review into one owner, collect comments privately, and move one consolidated answer.

candidate.prompt: Ask a few key reviewers to comment in parallel and keep the review window explicit and short.

candidate.prompt: Open the draft to a broad comment round and ask the wider group to respond quickly.

branch_event.subject: Policy draft for confirmations
branch_event.snippet:
Laurel Adams
09/27/99 01:47 PM
To: Mark - ECT Legal Taylor/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc:  
Subject: Policy draft for confirmations

Mark, 

Below please find my policy draft for confirm generation guidelines.  As I 
would ultimately like for someone from legal to officially sign off on 
something like this, please review with that in mind.  Thanks very much.  
Please call  me if you have questions or comments.  

"All FX deals are to be verbally confirmed as soon as possible after the 
trade is executed.   A comment should be written on the deal ticket noting 
who the deal was confirmed with and the date a

candidates.label: Single-owner consolidation
candidates.prompt: Collapse the review into one owner, collect comments privately, and move one consolidated answer.

candidates.label: Small review circle
candidates.prompt: Keep a small review circle, avoid broad recirculation, and use one controlled comment pass.

candidates.label: Parallel review request
candidates.prompt: Ask a few key reviewers to comment in parallel and keep the review window explicit and short.

candidates.label: Broad comment blast
candidates.prompt: Open the draft to a broad comment round and ask the wider group to respond quickly.

objective_pack.title: Minimize Enterprise Risk
objective_pack.summary: Favor choices that reduce outside spread, escalation heat, and legal or conflict burden.

candidate.label: Parallel review request
candidate.prompt: Ask a few key reviewers to comment in parallel and keep the review window explicit and short.

candidate.label: Single-owner consolidation
candidate.prompt: Collapse the review into one owner, collect comments privately, and move one consolidated answer.

candidate.label: Broad comment blast
candidate.prompt: Open the draft to a broad comment round and ask the wider group to respond quickly.

candidate.label: Small review circle
candidate.prompt: Keep a small review circle, avoid broad recirculation, and use one controlled comment pass.

candidates.label: Private manager channel

candidates.label: HR partner review

candidates.label: Small panel alignment
candidates.prompt: Use a small panel of relevant leaders, align the message, and avoid a wider emotional escalation.

candidates.label: Broad organizational escalation
candidates.prompt: Escalate the issue broadly across the organization to get a faster answer and broader buy-in.

Sherron S. Watkins
Vice President, Enron Corp.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports recurring earnings growth in 1997 and sets up 1998 growth platform
history_preview.snippet: Archived year-end earnings release describing 1997 results and the company's 1998 growth posture.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports second quarter 1998 earnings of $0.42 per share
history_preview.snippet: Archived second-quarter 1998 earnings release describing continued wholesale growth and contract execution.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports third quarter 1998 earnings and raises the annual dividend
history_preview.snippet: Archived third-quarter 1998 earnings release covering wholesale growth, retail expansion, and dividend increase.

history_preview.subject: FY1998 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $31.26B, net income was $703M, total assets were $29.35B, shareholders' equity was $7.05B, and diluted EPS was $1.01.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports increased earnings results for the first quarter of 1999
history_preview.snippet: Archived first-quarter 1999 earnings release describing wholesale strength, retail contracting, and growing credit-market exposure.

history_preview.subject: FY1999 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $40.11B, net income was $893M, total assets were $33.38B, shareholders' equity was $9.57B, and diluted EPS was $1.10.

history_preview.subject: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

history_preview.subject: Enron files its Form 10-K for fiscal year 1999
history_preview.snippet: Annual report and Form 10-K filing covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 1999.

history_preview.subject: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
history_preview.snippet: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported first-quarter revenues of $13.1B, net income of $338M, and diluted EPS of $0.40.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
history_preview.snippet: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

history_preview.subject: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

history_preview.subject: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
history_preview.snippet: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported second-quarter revenues of $16.9B, net income of $289M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
history_preview.snippet: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

history_preview.subject: Q3 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported third-quarter revenues of $30.0B, net income of $292M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Fitch baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: FY2000 Form 10-K
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $100.79B, net income was $979M, total assets were $65.50B, shareholders' equity was $11.47B, and diluted EPS was $1.12.

history_preview.subject: Moody's baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at Baa1 in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: S&P baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: Q4 2000 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported recurring annual diluted EPS of $1.47 for 2000 and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.41.

history_preview.subject: PG&E files for Chapter 11 protection
history_preview.snippet: SEC filing record documenting PG&E's April 6, 2001 bankruptcy filing.

history_preview.subject: PG&E entered Chapter 11
history_preview.snippet: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported first-quarter diluted EPS of $0.47, revenues of $50.1B, and net income of $406M.

history_preview.subject: Vice chairman Cliff Baxter resigned
history_preview.snippet: Enron's archived 2001 press chronology records Cliff Baxter's resignation on May 2, 2001.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed Western mitigation and opened the refund path
history_preview.snippet: The June 19, 2001 FERC action turned California power-market conduct and refund exposure into a concrete public regulatory fact.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed mitigation and opened the California refund path
history_preview.snippet: Public reporting on the June 19, 2001 FERC action put Enron and other sellers on notice that California crisis sales would face a refund and mitigation regime.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported second-quarter diluted EPS of $0.45 and net income of $404M.

history_preview.subject: Jeffrey Skilling resigns as chief executive officer
history_preview.snippet: Public resignation record that marks the executive transition during Enron's disclosure spiral.

history_preview.subject: Jeff Skilling resigned as chief executive
history_preview.snippet: Enron announced Skilling's resignation for personal reasons and said Kenneth Lay would resume the president and chief executive role.

history_preview.subject: Q3 2001 loss announcement
history_preview.snippet: Enron announced $1.01B of after-tax non-recurring charges, which resulted in a net loss for the quarter.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a third-quarter loss
history_preview.snippet: The company disclosed $1.01B in after-tax non-recurring charges and said the quarter ended in a net loss.

history_preview.subject: SEC requested information about related-party transactions
history_preview.snippet: Enron said the SEC had asked it to voluntarily provide information about certain related-party transactions.

history_preview.subject: Moody's kept Enron under review for downgrade
history_preview.snippet: Public credit-rating reporting showed Enron's investment-grade status was under acute pressure as liquidity concerns deepened.

history_preview.subject: Moody's cut Enron to Baa2 and kept it under review
history_preview.snippet: Moody's lowered Enron's senior unsecured debt to Baa2 and kept the rating under review for downgrade.

candidates.label: Escalate to the audit committee
candidates.prompt: Escalate the warning to the audit committee, copy one Andersen contact, and force a formal accounting review before anything else moves.

candidates.label: Hold for Vinson & Elkins review
candidates.prompt: Hold the issue inside a small legal circle, route it to Vinson & Elkins, and wait for outside-counsel guidance before wider disclosure.

candidates.label: Send an anonymous warning
candidates.prompt: Push a narrow warning to Ken Lay, keep the loop tiny, and ask for a direct answer without opening a larger circulation list.

candidates.label: Suppress and monitor
candidates.prompt: Keep the concern private, avoid wider disclosure, and monitor the situation without opening a formal review.

public_context.integration_hint: At integration time, compute the oldest and latest email timestamps from the active Enron slice and keep only financial_snapshots and public_news_events whose dates overlap that email window.

financial_snapshots.label: FY1998 selected financial data
financial_snapshots.summary: Operating revenue was $31.26B, net income was $703M, total assets were $29.35B, shareholders' equity was $7.05B, and diluted EPS was $1.01.

financial_snapshots.label: FY1999 selected financial data
financial_snapshots.summary: Operating revenue was $40.11B, net income was $893M, total assets were $33.38B, shareholders' equity was $9.57B, and diluted EPS was $1.10.

financial_snapshots.label: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

financial_snapshots.label: Q1 2000 earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron reported first-quarter revenues of $13.1B, net income of $338M, and diluted EPS of $0.40.

financial_snapshots.label: Q2 2000 earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron reported second-quarter revenues of $16.9B, net income of $289M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

financial_snapshots.label: Q3 2000 earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron reported third-quarter revenues of $30.0B, net income of $292M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

financial_snapshots.label: FY2000 Form 10-K
financial_snapshots.summary: Operating revenue was $100.79B, net income was $979M, total assets were $65.50B, shareholders' equity was $11.47B, and diluted EPS was $1.12.

financial_snapshots.label: Q4 2000 annual earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron publicly reported recurring annual diluted EPS of $1.47 for 2000 and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.41.

financial_snapshots.label: Q1 2001 earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron publicly reported first-quarter diluted EPS of $0.47, revenues of $50.1B, and net income of $406M.

financial_snapshots.label: Q2 2001 earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron publicly reported second-quarter diluted EPS of $0.45 and net income of $404M.

financial_snapshots.label: Q3 2001 loss announcement
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron announced $1.01B of after-tax non-recurring charges, which resulted in a net loss for the quarter.

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

public_news_events.headline: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
public_news_events.summary: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

public_news_events.headline: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
public_news_events.summary: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

public_news_events.headline: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

public_news_events.headline: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
public_news_events.summary: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
public_news_events.summary: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

public_news_events.headline: PG&E entered Chapter 11
public_news_events.summary: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

public_news_events.headline: Vice chairman Cliff Baxter resigned
public_news_events.summary: Enron's archived 2001 press chronology records Cliff Baxter's resignation on May 2, 2001.

public_news_events.headline: FERC imposed mitigation and opened the California refund path
public_news_events.summary: Public reporting on the June 19, 2001 FERC action put Enron and other sellers on notice that California crisis sales would face a refund and mitigation regime.

public_news_events.headline: Jeff Skilling resigned as chief executive
public_news_events.summary: Enron announced Skilling's resignation for personal reasons and said Kenneth Lay would resume the president and chief executive role.

public_news_events.headline: Enron announced a third-quarter loss
public_news_events.summary: The company disclosed $1.01B in after-tax non-recurring charges and said the quarter ended in a net loss.

public_news_events.headline: SEC requested information about related-party transactions
public_news_events.summary: Enron said the SEC had asked it to voluntarily provide information about certain related-party transactions.

public_news_events.headline: Moody's kept Enron under review for downgrade
public_news_events.summary: Public credit-rating reporting showed Enron's investment-grade status was under acute pressure as liquidity concerns deepened.

objective_pack.title: Minimize Enterprise Risk
objective_pack.summary: Favor choices that reduce outside spread, escalation heat, and legal or conflict burden.

candidate.prompt: Push a narrow warning to Ken Lay, keep the loop tiny, and ask for a direct answer without opening a larger circulation list.

candidate.label: Suppress and monitor
candidate.prompt: Keep the concern private, avoid wider disclosure, and monitor the situation without opening a formal review.

candidate.label: Escalate to the audit committee
candidate.prompt: Escalate the warning to the audit committee, copy one Andersen contact, and force a formal accounting review before anything else moves.

candidate.label: Hold for Vinson & Elkins review
candidate.prompt: Hold the issue inside a small legal circle, route it to Vinson & Elkins, and wait for outside-counsel guidance before wider disclosure.

case.title: California Crisis Preservation Order
case.summary: A California Attorney General preservation order lands on the trading desk while the crisis strategy is active.

branch_event.subject: IMPORTANT - READ IMMEDIATELY
branch_event.snippet:
We have just received an order from the California Attorney General requiring 
all employees (except legal, admin, and human resources staff) to take the 
following steps immediately:

   1.  Save all e-mails, i.e., don't delete any e-mails.
   2.  Do not delete any information in databases.
   3.  Do not delete any word processing files or file fragments.
   4.  Do not delete any excel spreadsheets or calendars or scheduling 
programs. 
   5.  Any other electronic data not otherwise covered.

This request is being made in connection with the California AG's 
investigation into electricity pri

candidates.label: Board and audit disclosure
candidates.prompt: Escalate the draft to the board and audit committee, keep one owner on the message, and align disclosure language before the broader release.

candidates.label: Controlled internal draft
candidates.prompt: Keep the communications draft internal, use one owner and one legal reviewer, and hold external statements until the draft is settled.

candidates.label: Narrow external line
candidates.prompt: Send one narrow status line to the outside audience, keep the detail light, and give one clear next-step owner.

candidates.label: Broad reassurance loop
candidates.prompt: Push the talking points broadly, reassure everyone quickly, and let multiple leaders speak into the message at once.

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

public_news_events.headline: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
public_news_events.summary: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

public_news_events.headline: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
public_news_events.summary: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

public_news_events.headline: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

public_news_events.headline: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
public_news_events.summary: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
public_news_events.summary: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports third quarter 1998 earnings and raises the annual dividend
history_preview.snippet: Archived third-quarter 1998 earnings release covering wholesale growth, retail expansion, and dividend increase.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports increased earnings results for the first quarter of 1999
history_preview.snippet: Archived first-quarter 1999 earnings release describing wholesale strength, retail contracting, and growing credit-market exposure.

history_preview.subject: FY1999 selected financial data

history_preview.subject: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

history_preview.subject: Enron files its Form 10-K for fiscal year 1999
history_preview.snippet: Annual report and Form 10-K filing covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 1999.

history_preview.subject: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
history_preview.snippet: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported first-quarter revenues of $13.1B, net income of $338M, and diluted EPS of $0.40.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
history_preview.snippet: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

history_preview.subject: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

history_preview.subject: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
history_preview.snippet: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported second-quarter revenues of $16.9B, net income of $289M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
history_preview.snippet: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

history_preview.subject: Q3 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported third-quarter revenues of $30.0B, net income of $292M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Fitch baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: FY2000 Form 10-K
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $100.79B, net income was $979M, total assets were $65.50B, shareholders' equity was $11.47B, and diluted EPS was $1.12.

history_preview.subject: S&P baseline senior debt rating

history_preview.subject: Q4 2000 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported recurring annual diluted EPS of $1.47 for 2000 and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.41.

history_preview.subject: PG&E files for Chapter 11 protection
history_preview.snippet: SEC filing record documenting PG&E's April 6, 2001 bankruptcy filing.

history_preview.subject: PG&E entered Chapter 11
history_preview.snippet: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported first-quarter diluted EPS of $0.47, revenues of $50.1B, and net income of $406M.

history_preview.subject: Vice chairman Cliff Baxter resigned
history_preview.snippet: Enron's archived 2001 press chronology records Cliff Baxter's resignation on May 2, 2001.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed Western mitigation and opened the refund path
history_preview.snippet: The June 19, 2001 FERC action turned California power-market conduct and refund exposure into a concrete public regulatory fact.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed mitigation and opened the California refund path
history_preview.snippet: Public reporting on the June 19, 2001 FERC action put Enron and other sellers on notice that California crisis sales would face a refund and mitigation regime.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported second-quarter diluted EPS of $0.45 and net income of $404M.

history_preview.subject: Jeffrey Skilling resigns as chief executive officer

history_preview.subject: Jeff Skilling resigned as chief executive
history_preview.snippet: Enron announced Skilling's resignation for personal reasons and said Kenneth Lay would resume the president and chief executive role.

history_preview.snippet: Enron announced $1.01B of after-tax non-recurring charges, which resulted in a net loss for the quarter.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a third-quarter loss
history_preview.snippet: The company disclosed $1.01B in after-tax non-recurring charges and said the quarter ended in a net loss.

history_preview.subject: SEC requested information about related-party transactions
history_preview.snippet: Enron said the SEC had asked it to voluntarily provide information about certain related-party transactions.

history_preview.subject: Moody's kept Enron under review for downgrade
history_preview.snippet: Public credit-rating reporting showed Enron's investment-grade status was under acute pressure as liquidity concerns deepened.

history_preview.subject: Moody's cut Enron to Baa2 and kept it under review
history_preview.snippet: Moody's lowered Enron's senior unsecured debt to Baa2 and kept the rating under review for downgrade.

history_preview.subject: Board formed a special committee and the SEC opened a formal investigation
history_preview.snippet: Enron said its board appointed a special committee and that the SEC had opened a formal investigation into the matters under review.

candidates.label: Board and audit disclosure
candidates.prompt: Escalate the draft to the board and audit committee, keep one owner on the message, and align disclosure language before the broader release.

candidates.label: Controlled internal draft
candidates.prompt: Keep the communications draft internal, use one owner and one legal reviewer, and hold external statements until the draft is settled.

candidates.label: Narrow external line
candidates.prompt: Send one narrow status line to the outside audience, keep the detail light, and give one clear next-step owner.

candidates.label: Broad reassurance loop
candidates.prompt: Push the talking points broadly, reassure everyone quickly, and let multiple leaders speak into the message at once.

public_context.integration_hint: At integration time, compute the oldest and latest email timestamps from the active Enron slice and keep only financial_snapshots and public_news_events whose dates overlap that email window.

financial_snapshots.label: FY1998 selected financial data
financial_snapshots.summary: Operating revenue was $31.26B, net income was $703M, total assets were $29.35B, shareholders' equity was $7.05B, and diluted EPS was $1.01.

financial_snapshots.label: FY1999 selected financial data
financial_snapshots.summary: Operating revenue was $40.11B, net income was $893M, total assets were $33.38B, shareholders' equity was $9.57B, and diluted EPS was $1.10.

financial_snapshots.label: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
financial_snapshots.summary: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

financial_snapshots.label: Q1 2000 earnings release

financial_snapshots.label: Q2 2000 earnings release

financial_snapshots.label: Q3 2000 earnings release

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

public_news_events.headline: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
public_news_events.summary: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

public_news_events.headline: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
public_news_events.summary: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

public_news_events.headline: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
public_news_events.summary: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

public_news_events.headline: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
public_news_events.summary: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

public_news_events.headline: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
public_news_events.summary: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

public_news_events.headline: PG&E entered Chapter 11
public_news_events.summary: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

public_news_events.headline: Vice chairman Cliff Baxter resigned
public_news_events.summary: Enron's archived 2001 press chronology records Cliff Baxter's resignation on May 2, 2001.

public_news_events.headline: FERC imposed mitigation and opened the California refund path
public_news_events.summary: Public reporting on the June 19, 2001 FERC action put Enron and other sellers on notice that California crisis sales would face a refund and mitigation regime.

public_news_events.headline: Jeff Skilling resigned as chief executive
public_news_events.summary: Enron announced Skilling's resignation for personal reasons and said Kenneth Lay would resume the president and chief executive role.

public_news_events.headline: Enron announced a third-quarter loss
public_news_events.summary: The company disclosed $1.01B in after-tax non-recurring charges and said the quarter ended in a net loss.

public_news_events.summary: Enron said the SEC had asked it to voluntarily provide information about certain related-party transactions.

public_news_events.headline: Moody's kept Enron under review for downgrade
public_news_events.summary: Public credit-rating reporting showed Enron's investment-grade status was under acute pressure as liquidity concerns deepened.

case.summary: The year-end EES update captures accounting and coordination pressure at a disclosure-sensitive moment.

branch_event.subject: EES Pre-holiday Update
branch_event.snippet:
To: Ted Murphy/HOU/ECT@ECT,  Yahoo Mail, Cassandra Schultz/NA/Enron@Enron, 
David Port/Market Risk/Corp/Enron@ENRON, Minal Dalia/HOU/EES@EES, Andy 
Knight/Corp/Enron@ENRON, Darin Schmidt/NA/Enron@ENRON
cc:  (bcc: John J Lavorato/Corp/Enron)

Subject: EES Pre-holiday Update

Regulatory:

Based on the on-going CA PUC hearings and opinions of Enron legal and 
regulatory groups, it seems that the Commission is likely to increase tariff 
rates by anywhere from 10 to 20% (PG&E and SCE are arguing for a 30% increase 
- not realistic). The critical decision is to leave EES direct-access

candidates.label: Disclose and restate
candidates.prompt: Disclose the issue, route it through legal and accounting immediately, and prepare the restatement path before quarter-end pressure widens.

candidates.label: Hold for clean reconciliation
candidates.prompt: Keep the issue inside a small finance and legal loop, reconcile the numbers, and hold the wider message until the clean story is ready.

candidates.label: Restructure in a limited circle
candidates.prompt: Keep the discussion to a limited finance circle, restructure the path quietly, and avoid opening a broader disclosure loop yet.

candidates.label: Push through quarter close
candidates.prompt: Push the item through quarter close, keep the loop broad enough to execute fast, and postpone the harder accounting clean-up.

candidates.label: Disclose and restate
candidates.prompt: Disclose the issue, route it through legal and accounting immediately, and prepare the restatement path before quarter-end pressure widens.

candidates.label: Hold for clean reconciliation
candidates.prompt: Keep the issue inside a small finance and legal loop, reconcile the numbers, and hold the wider message until the clean story is ready.

candidates.label: Restructure in a limited circle
candidates.prompt: Keep the discussion to a limited finance circle, restructure the path quietly, and avoid opening a broader disclosure loop yet.

candidates.label: Push through quarter close
candidates.prompt: Push the item through quarter close, keep the loop broad enough to execute fast, and postpone the harder accounting clean-up.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports recurring earnings growth in 1997 and sets up 1998 growth platform
history_preview.snippet: Archived year-end earnings release describing 1997 results and the company's 1998 growth posture.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports second quarter 1998 earnings of $0.42 per share
history_preview.snippet: Archived second-quarter 1998 earnings release describing continued wholesale growth and contract execution.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports third quarter 1998 earnings and raises the annual dividend
history_preview.snippet: Archived third-quarter 1998 earnings release covering wholesale growth, retail expansion, and dividend increase.

history_preview.subject: FY1998 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $31.26B, net income was $703M, total assets were $29.35B, shareholders' equity was $7.05B, and diluted EPS was $1.01.

history_preview.subject: Enron reports increased earnings results for the first quarter of 1999
history_preview.snippet: Archived first-quarter 1999 earnings release describing wholesale strength, retail contracting, and growing credit-market exposure.

history_preview.subject: FY1999 selected financial data
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $40.11B, net income was $893M, total assets were $33.38B, shareholders' equity was $9.57B, and diluted EPS was $1.10.

history_preview.subject: Q4 1999 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported full-year 1999 revenues of $40.0B, net income of $957M before nonrecurring items, annual diluted EPS of $1.18, and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.31.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched its first online emissions allowance auction
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline would host the first online sulfur dioxide emissions allowance auction and planned to run the auctions monthly.

history_preview.subject: Enron files its Form 10-K for fiscal year 1999
history_preview.snippet: Annual report and Form 10-K filing covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 1999.

history_preview.subject: Enron signed a $610M long-term electricity agreement with IBM
history_preview.snippet: Enron Energy Services said it would supply or procure electricity for IBM under a ten-year agreement valued at $610M.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported first-quarter revenues of $13.1B, net income of $338M, and diluted EPS of $0.40.

history_preview.subject: Enron announced a cash offer for MG plc
history_preview.snippet: Enron said its recommended cash offer valued MG plc at $446M and would extend Enron's business model into metals.

history_preview.subject: EnronOnline passed $50B of transaction value in 2000
history_preview.snippet: Enron said EnronOnline had exceeded $50B of transaction value in calendar 2000 and had already beaten its yearly projection.

history_preview.subject: Enron and Blockbuster announced a 20-year on-demand service deal
history_preview.snippet: Enron Broadband Services and Blockbuster announced a 20-year exclusive agreement to launch an entertainment-on-demand service.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported second-quarter revenues of $16.9B, net income of $289M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Enron launched Clickpaper.com for the forest products market
history_preview.snippet: Enron Industrial Markets launched Clickpaper.com as an Internet transaction system for pulp, paper, and wood commodities.

history_preview.subject: Q3 2000 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron reported third-quarter revenues of $30.0B, net income of $292M, and diluted EPS of $0.34.

history_preview.subject: Fitch baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: FY2000 Form 10-K
history_preview.snippet: Operating revenue was $100.79B, net income was $979M, total assets were $65.50B, shareholders' equity was $11.47B, and diluted EPS was $1.12.

history_preview.subject: Moody's baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at Baa1 in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: S&P baseline senior debt rating
history_preview.snippet: Enron's senior debt was listed at BBB+ in the 2000 financial highlights.

history_preview.subject: Q4 2000 annual earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported recurring annual diluted EPS of $1.47 for 2000 and fourth-quarter diluted EPS of $0.41.

history_preview.subject: PG&E files for Chapter 11 protection
history_preview.snippet: SEC filing record documenting PG&E's April 6, 2001 bankruptcy filing.

history_preview.subject: PG&E entered Chapter 11
history_preview.snippet: PG&E's Chapter 11 filing made California power-counterparty risk a public fact before later Enron branch points tied to power trading and structured deals.

history_preview.subject: Q1 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported first-quarter diluted EPS of $0.47, revenues of $50.1B, and net income of $406M.

history_preview.subject: Vice chairman Cliff Baxter resigned
history_preview.snippet: Enron's archived 2001 press chronology records Cliff Baxter's resignation on May 2, 2001.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed Western mitigation and opened the refund path
history_preview.snippet: The June 19, 2001 FERC action turned California power-market conduct and refund exposure into a concrete public regulatory fact.

history_preview.subject: FERC imposed mitigation and opened the California refund path
history_preview.snippet: Public reporting on the June 19, 2001 FERC action put Enron and other sellers on notice that California crisis sales would face a refund and mitigation regime.

history_preview.subject: Q2 2001 earnings release
history_preview.snippet: Enron publicly reported second-quarter diluted EPS of $0.45 and net income of $404M.

history_preview.subject: Jeffrey Skilling resigns as chief executive officer
history_preview.snippet: Public resignation record that marks the executive transition during Enron's disclosure spiral.

history_preview.subject: Jeff Skilling resigned as chief executive
history_preview.snippet: Enron announced Skilling's resignation for personal reasons and said Kenneth Lay would resume the president and chief executive role.

candidates.label: Board and audit disclosure
candidates.prompt: Escalate the draft to the board and audit committee, keep one owner on the message, and align disclosure language before the broader release.

candidates.label: Controlled internal draft
candidates.prompt: Keep the communications draft internal, use one owner and one legal reviewer, and hold external statements until the draft is settled.

candidates.label: Narrow external line
candidates.prompt: Send one narrow status line to the outside audience, keep the detail light, and give one clear next-step owner.

candidates.label: Broad reassurance loop
candidates.prompt: Push the talking points broadly, reassure everyone quickly, and let multiple leaders speak into the message at once.
